reproduction.real_cli_command:
set -eu
fence_cli="$PWD/engines/hermes/_build/default/modules/sa_plan/test/sa_plan_main.exe"
fence_tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/uos-fence-cli.XXXXXX)
export UOS_SA_PLAN_DB="$fence_tmp/store.sqlite3"
fence_log="$fence_tmp/checks.txt"
run() { "$fence_cli" "$@" >> "$fence_log" 2>&1; }
reject() {
  fence_expected=$1
  shift
  if "$fence_cli" "$@" >> "$fence_log" 2>&1; then
    printf 'UNSAFE acceptance: %s\n' "$*" >&2
    exit 1
  else
    fence_exit=$?
    [ "$fence_exit" -eq "$fence_expected" ] || exit "$fence_exit"
  fi
}
attempt() { sed -n 's/.*attempt=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p'; }
run plan create p fence/cli "CLI fencing"
run task create p t fence/cli/task "Task"
fence_first=$("$fence_cli" task claim same p 30000000000 t 2>> "$fence_log" | attempt)
[ "$fence_first" = 1 ]
reject 2 task complete p t same done
run task release p t same "$fence_first"
fence_second=$("$fence_cli" task claim same p 30000000000 t 2>> "$fence_log" | attempt)
[ "$fence_second" = 2 ]
reject 1 task complete p t same "$fence_first" stale
reject 1 task release p t same "$fence_first"
run task complete p t same "$fence_second" done
"$fence_cli" task show p t 2>> "$fence_log" | rg 'state=completed' >> "$fence_log"
run job enqueue j fence/cli/job q fixture '{}' 3
fence_job_first=$("$fence_cli" job claim q same 1 2>> "$fence_log" | attempt)
[ "$fence_job_first" = 1 ]
reject 1 job complete j same "$fence_job_first" OK expired
fence_job_second=$("$fence_cli" job claim q same 30000000000 2>> "$fence_log" | attempt)
[ "$fence_job_second" = 2 ]
reject 1 job complete j same "$fence_job_first" OK stale
run job complete j same "$fence_job_second" OK done
"$fence_cli" job list q 2>> "$fence_log" | rg 'state=completed' >> "$fence_log"
printf 'CLI_FENCING_PASS task_attempts=%s,%s job_attempts=%s,%s rejected=5 log=%s\n' "$fence_first" "$fence_second" "$fence_job_first" "$fence_job_second" "$fence_log"
